description:
About the Role

We're looking for a resourceful, analytical, and execution-obsessed B2B Growth Marketing Specialist to become the operational backbone of our marketing team. This is a hybrid role that spans demand generation, event operations, campaign execution, and marketing ops, all with a relentless focus on pipeline growth and efficiency.

You'll own programs end-to-end: from building the strategy and managing vendor relationships to tracking budgets, analyzing results, and iterating fast. Events are an important part of the mix, but so are ABM plays, content-driven lead gen, partner marketing, and everything in between.

We need someone who doesn't wait for instructions. You see a gap, you fill it. You use AI tools daily to multiply your output. You're as comfortable building a campaign report in HubSpot as you are negotiating a venue contract or writing a landing page brief. If you thrive in fast-paced, "do more with less" environments, this role is for you.




Key Responsibilities

Event Marketing & Field Programs

Manage the end-to-end logistics of B2B marketing events: trade shows, hosted dinners, executive roundtables, webinars, virtual summits, and partner activations.

Manage multiple vendor and agency relationships simultaneously, ensuring deliverables are on time, on budget, and on brand.
Maintain rigorous project management practices across all workstreams — timelines, briefs, status updates, and stakeholder alignment.

Marketing Operations & Analytics

Be able to manage workflows, lead scoring, email automation, campaign attribution, list segmentation, and reporting dashboards on HubSpot.
Ensure data hygiene across the CRM: proper UTM tagging, lead source tracking, duplicate management, and lifecycle stage accuracy.
Build and maintain performance dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into marketing's impact on pipeline and revenue.
Analyze campaign and channel performance to deliver actionable insights and recommendations to the team.

Identify and implement automation opportunities to eliminate manual, repetitive work across marketing operations.
Stay on top of emerging AI-powered martech tools and proactively bring recommendations to the team.
Be a force multiplier — consistently deliver the output of a much larger team by working smarter with technology.

Work closely with Sales to ensure marketing programs/events are aligned with pipeline goals, territory plans, and target account lists.
Partner with Product Marketing to translate product narratives into demand gen campaigns and event messaging.
Provide regular performance updates and strategic recommendations to leadership.




What You Bring

Must-Have

4+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in roles that combined demand gen, events, and marketing ops.
A genuine growth mindset — you're metrics-driven, experiment-happy, and always looking for the next lever to pull.
Solid experience managing events and marketing budgets, vendor contracts, and multi-vendor logistics.
Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot (Marketing Hub & CRM).
Strong analytical skills: you're comfortable in spreadsheets, dashboards, and data. You make decisions with numbers, not gut feeling.
Heavy, daily user of AI tools: you already use AI to write, analyze, automate, and create. This is non-negotiable.
Exceptional organizational skills: you manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders without dropping balls.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Spanish.
Based in Mexico City with availability for occasional travel.

Nice-to-Have

Experience in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS B2B environments.
Familiarity with ABM platforms (Demandbase, 6sense, HubSpot ABM).
Experience with paid media management (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta).
Knowledge of SEO/SEM fundamentals and content marketing strategy.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Zenit Corp

Zenit Corp is a fast growing ecommerce group that owns and operates multiple DTC brands across different markets.

We are building a portfolio of high potential ecommerce brands with strong fundamentals, scalable systems, and ambitious long term growth plans. Our goal is to create a multi brand ecommerce group capable of reaching significant scale across different verticals.

The company is currently in a high growth stage and this creates a unique opportunity for people joining now to take ownership, grow with the company, and help shape the next stage of the group.

This is an opportunity to join early, take ownership, create impact, and help build the creative strategy function of a group with ambitious long term goals.




Role

The Creative Strategist is responsible for connecting marketing performance with creative execution. This person turns research, data, customer psychology, and business priorities into clear creative direction for paid social, landing pages, campaign concepts, and content tests.

This role is not limited to coming up with ideas. The Creative Strategist is responsible for building a structured creative process, identifying winning angles, writing strong creative briefs, analyzing what is working, and helping the team produce ads designed to perform.

This person works directly with the Head Of Marketing and marketing team, and collaborates with media buyers, designers, editors, copywriters, and creators to make sure creative output is aligned with growth objectives.

The role is expected to bring taste, structure, speed, and performance oriented thinking to a growing ecommerce group.




Creative Strategist Responsibilities




❖ Creative Strategy & Research

➢ Research customers, competitors, market trends, ad libraries, reviews, comments, and social platforms to identify strong creative opportunities.

➢ Translate customer motivations, objections, desires, and buying triggers into creative angles, hooks, messages, and offers.

➢ Build a clear understanding of each brand’s positioning and customer psychology.

➢ Stay close to what is working across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.




❖ Ad Concepts, Hooks & Creative Briefs

➢ Develop new ad concepts, hooks, scripts, storyboards, UGC directions, landing page ideas, and campaign angles.

➢ Write clear creative briefs that explain the objective, target customer, key message, structure, examples, and success criteria.

➢ Create both quick iterations and bigger creative tests that can help unlock new performance.

➢ Maintain an organized backlog of creative tests, angles, and hypotheses for each brand.




❖ Performance Analysis & Creative Testing

➢ Analyze creative performance with the marketing team to understand what drives clicks, conversions, CPA, ROAS, retention, and scale.

➢ Identify patterns in winning and losing creatives and turn those patterns into new tests.

➢ Help define creative testing roadmaps and prioritize the ideas most likely to improve performance.

➢ Create feedback loops between performance results and future creative production.




❖ Collaboration With Creative Production

➢ Work closely with designers, editors, copywriters, media buyers, creators, and other team members to turn ideas into finished assets.

➢ Give clear, practical, and constructive feedback on creative work.

➢ Make sure creative assets are aligned with the brief, the brand, the customer insight, and the performance goal.

➢ Build repeatable frameworks, references, and standards that help the team produce better creative over time.




❖ Brand, Customer & Market Understanding

➢ Protect each brand’s positioning while still pushing for strong direct response performance.

➢ Use customer language to improve ads, landing pages, hooks, and messages.

➢ Identify new angles based on customer objections, product benefits, competitive gaps, and market shifts.

➢ Help the company build a stronger creative foundation as the group grows.




What This Role Is Not

➢ This role is not a traditional Creative Director role focused only on visual taste or brand aesthetics.

➢ This role is not a graphic designer, video editor, or content creator role, although it works closely with those functions.

➢ This role is not responsible for managing ad spend or making final media buying decisions alone.

➢ This role is not a pure social media management or community management role.

➢ This role is not responsible for defining company strategy on its own.

➢ This role is not about producing random ideas without research, structure, testing, or performance accountability.




The Creative Strategist owns creative research, angles, briefs, testing direction, performance learning, and creative feedback loops. The Head Of Marketing and marketing leadership own final business priorities, budgets, and strategic decisions.




Compensation & Benefits

➢ Compensation package of up to 25k USD including bonus, depending on experience, scope of responsibility, and performance.

➢ Opportunity to play a key role inside a rapidly growing ecommerce group.

➢ Direct exposure to company strategy, performance marketing, creative production, and brand growth.

➢ High ownership over the creation of the group’s creative strategy function.

➢ Clear path toward becoming a key creative and growth leader within a multi brand ecommerce group.

➢ Additional performance bonuses for working ads: when a concept, hook, script, or creative brief becomes a strong performing ad and materially helps improve results, the role can receive extra upside tied to that impact.




Ideal Candidate

➢ Strong creative strategy profile with the ability to connect customer insight, storytelling, and performance data.

➢ Comfortable working directly with a founder led leadership team.

➢ Able to create clear, useful, and execution oriented creative briefs.

➢ Strong understanding of paid social creative, direct response marketing, customer psychology, hooks, angles, offers, and creative testing.

➢ Comfortable analyzing ad performance and translating data into practical creative improvements.

➢ Strong written communication and copywriting ability.

➢ Highly organized, reliable, and comfortable building systems from scratch in a fast moving company.

➢ Able to collaborate with designers, editors, media buyers, copywriters, creators, and marketing operators.

➢ Has strong taste, customer empathy, and performance oriented judgment.

➢ Ambitious and comfortable operating in a fast paced, high growth environment.

➢ Previous experience in ecommerce, DTC brands, performance marketing, paid social, creative strategy, UGC, advertising, copywriting, or growth teams is highly valued.

➢ Fluent written and spoken English, C1 level mandatory.

description:
About The Role And Team

Uber is about much more than getting a safe and reliable ride from A to B—we’re redefining how people and things move through cities and people connect with their communities. As a Communications Associate, you will be the voice of this transformation, turning complex technological shifts into human stories that resonate with journalists and the public alike. You’ll join a team of high-energy storytellers who manage our reputation across dynamic markets, ensuring that the benefits of our mobility and delivery platforms are front and center in every conversation.

Working in Comms at Uber means moving at the speed of the news cycle in an environment where the stakes are high and the answers aren't always in a playbook. You’ll need to balance proactive campaign building with the grit required to handle reactive, high-profile media inquiries under pressure.

This role is for a self-starter who finds energy in ambiguity and is motivated by the challenge of shaping a narrative that impacts thousands of earners. Earner Comms is a critical bridge between business priorities and tailored earner engagement to help position Uber as the preferred platform.

What You’ll Do


 Own and strengthen earner trust: Identify and elevate credible earner stories across earned media, community channels, and strategic communications initiatives. 
Build relationships: Identify and develop trusted relationships with earners to position Uber as a platform that listens, responds, and delivers meaningful improvement for their experience.
Shape the narrative: Translate Uber’s earner priorities into compelling narratives that can resonate within earners. Strengthen direct communications and engagement through our channels and targeted earner networks. 
Provide feedback: Establish feedback loops with other teams to ensure earner perspectives are reflected in communications strategies and operational improvements.


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree
4+ years of professional experience in media relations, journalism, or a corporate communications role.
Exceptional storytelling skills with a proven ability to understand an issue from all sides and advocate for a clear position.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with executives and partners across a global organization.
A creative problem solver who can identify emerging trends and build impactful campaigns from scratch with limited information.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working in a fast-paced technology or consumer-facing industry where navigating tension and heat is part of the job.
Experience building relationships with communities and creating opportunities for two-way dialogue. Ability to anticipate reputational risks and coordinate timely, accurate and emphatic communications during business or regulatory changes.


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

En Le Creuset, encontrarás tu lugar en nuestra mesa, tan colorida como nuestros utensilios de cocina y rica en historia. Nuestra mesa se basa en nuestros valores: pasión, integridad, excelencia, innovación y trabajo en equipo.

¿Te apasiona el análisis de mercado y la gestión de cuentas? Únete a una empresa mexicana con 25 años de experiencia que impulsa la disponibilidad de productos en el punto de venta y el éxito de sus clientes en el sector retail.




Tu misión será analizar las condiciones del mercado y el comportamiento del consumidor para brindar insights valiosos que apoyen la toma de decisiones. Requisitos principales:

- Licenciatura en Matemáticas, Actuaría, Administración, Economía, Estadística o afines.

- Experiencia comprobable en investigación de mercados o análisis retail, preferentemente en consumo masivo.

- Gestión y atención de cuentas.

- Dominio avanzado de Microsoft Excel y Power BI.

- Conocimientos en técnicas de investigación de mercado y análisis cuantitativo/cualitativo.

-INDISPENSABLE: Vivir en CDMX.




Lo que ofrecemos:

- Sueldo competitivo.

-Prestaciones Superiores

- Ambiente profesional, colaborativo y enfocado en innovación.

- Oportunidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional continuo.

description:
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.




𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Remote




𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗦𝗵𝗶𝗳𝘁:

To best support our global hoteliers, our Hypercare Onboarding team operates across multiple time zones. We are currently looking for Coaches to fill the following shift options:

Thursday – Monday: 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM EST
Friday – Tuesday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST
Wednesday – Sunday: 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM EST

Please note: Shift details will be discussed during the interview process based on business needs as well as your preference and flexibility. Final shift allocation will be confirmed prior to an offer.




𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁:

As a 𝗛𝘆𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗢𝗻𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗖𝗼𝗮𝗰𝗵, you will step in at the most critical, high-stakes juncture of our clients' journey: the exact moment their business goes live on our platform. You will empower clients to transform their properties through our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission, ensuring they never feel abandoned when transitioning to their new live environment. This isn't a standard support queue; it's a high-touch, fast-paced launch zone where you act as a strategic operational partner.

Leveraging your firsthand hospitality experience, you won't just close technical tickets—you will analyze live data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and design processes that eliminate live-environment friction so hoteliers can focus entirely on their guests. This is a role for a 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗥𝗲𝗯𝗲𝗹 who models Hospitality Before Efficiency. You will personalize every interaction, shield your clients from technical overwhelm, and care for their properties just as you would for a guest walking into a 5-star hotel—always going the extra mile to deliver an experience of Unreasonable Hospitality.




𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿 𝗢𝗻𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:

Our Onboarding team is where 𝗛𝗼𝘀𝗽𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘁𝘀 meet 𝗦𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗦𝗼𝗹𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀. We are a fully-remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can spend more time on our "human magic": building and strengthening relationships, and ensuring our customers feel confident and supported from day one. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust-building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational tasks, you will feel right at home here.




𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:

Own the Post-Go-Live Safety Net:

You will champion the critical post-launch window, executing highly intensive interaction cadences to evaluate system health, assess team sentiment, and build deep product confidence during their first days live.

Standardize the Repeatable, Personalize the Meaningful:

You'll eagerly adopt AI tools and internal automation to handle administrative drag and resolve repetitive technical questions instantly, freeing you up to focus on strategic real-time guidance and building deep product adoption.

Crush Tight SLAs with a Maverick Edge:

You will manage a high-priority, fast-paced ticket queue and incoming hotlines with a strict turnaround time. As a true collaborator, you will jump on urgent, unscheduled calls or dive into the queue to help the global team clear critical client blockers across time zones when capacity demands it.

Investigate with Curiosity:

When a problem is deeply technical or ambiguous, you will dive in with a technical support-style mindset, investigating root causes, collaborating with internal product specialists, and turning complex errors into clean solutions.

Bridge the Gap to Long-Term Success:

You will facilitate the crucial transition from intensive technical configuration into long-term product utilization, empowering clients to become entirely self-sufficient before successfully handing them off to long-term relationship managers.

Maintain Flawless Context:

You'll embody the Caring Rebel mindset by keeping a clear, detailed record of account activities and health metrics in our CRM, ensuring no context is lost and converting live-environment customer feedback into actionable insights for our product teams.




𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀:

Show Strong AI Smarts:

Exceptional technical aptitude and learning agility. You pick up new systems rapidly, understand how to leverage modern AI tools to conquer daily volume, and thrive in an environment where technology and workflow routing models are constantly evolving.

Demonstrate Your Hospitality Heart:

Proven high emotional intelligence and trust-building skills. You are an Empathy Champion, capable of calming a stressed hotelier during a high-pressure launch, ensuring they feel fiercely protected and genuinely cared for.

Thrive in Fast-Paced Complexity:

Strong organizational and proactive skills. You can gracefully balance a schedule of dedicated customer follow-up calls alongside an active, immediate support queue without losing your cool.

Cross-Functional Alignment:

Ability to synthesize complex, live-environment feedback and share distinct customer insights across Sales, Product, and Support teams to drive overall client retention.

Proven Industry Background:

You bring over 3 years of 5-star hospitality experience in key operational roles (Front Desk, Operations, or Revenue Management) within a boutique or leading hotel brand, OR you possess at least 3 years of relevant B2B SaaS industry experience in a high-touch customer success, implementation, or technical support role within the Hospitality Industry. Hospitality degree preferred.




𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗱 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝘂𝘁:

Knowledge of Spanish, Portuguese, English, Thai, or Tagalog if not the mother tongue.
Project Management or Change Management certification.

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. AI-assisted editing. Applicants with experience using Claude to assist in their editing will be preferred.

Figma. Applicants with experience producing thumbnails using Figma and its associated AI capabilities will be preferred.

title: Growth Operator
description:
Growth Operator | Founding Team




ANEKO AI | Mexico City | Full-time




Want to start your own company someday? Come build with us first.




We’re looking for someone who wants a lot more than another job.




Someone who’s already built outbound systems, knows how to sell, is knee-deep in AI, and wants to learn everything else that goes into building a startup.




You’ll work directly with Aneko’s Founder & CEO and join the early team of a Techstars-backed healthcare AI company with global ambitions.




Your first focus will be growth. Where you go from there depends on what you make happen.




A little about ANEKO




Aneko was born from a personal experience with a delayed cancer diagnosis. Our mission is simple: No diagnosis should be made on missing information.




We’re starting by transforming medical imaging with AI, with a bigger vision of intelligent digital twins for clinicians that can move with them across healthcare systems.




We’re building technology with the potential to change how healthcare works and improve millions of lives.




What you’ll do




Your first challenge is helping build our growth engine.




* Build AI-powered outbound systems that generate qualified opportunities.

* Find creative ways to reach healthcare executives.

* Experiment with AI agents, Clay, automations, and whatever else gets results.

* Help develop marketing, messaging, content, and campaigns.

* Get involved in customer conversations and help move deals forward.




But you won’t be limited to growth. You’ll work across fundraising, partnerships, investor meetings, new markets, hiring, and whatever else the company needs.




You’ll wear multiple hats, get your hands dirty, and have a real say in how we grow.




What makes this opportunity different?




You’ll work alongside an experienced founder who’s spent years building and scaling technology companies.




You’ll meet investors, founders, and industry leaders. Travel to startup events and business meetings. Get firsthand exposure to fundraising, sales, marketing, product, and the decisions that shape a company.




You’ll have room to experiment, challenge ideas, take ownership, and learn from mistakes.




As ANEKO grows, we want you to grow with it. More responsibility, more ownership, and opportunities to lead.




The goal is to give future founders the kind of experience that would otherwise take years to gain.




Who we’re looking for




You’ve built outbound systems and have hands-on experience selling.




You’re constantly experimenting with AI tools, agents, and automation.




You’re creative, resourceful, curious, and know how to figure things out.




You can think big while paying attention to details and following through.




You’re fluent in English. Native-level fluency is a big plus.




You have real entrepreneurial ambition and want to challenge yourself the build big! 




Location and travel requirements:




Must currently reside in Mexico City. This position is exclusively for candidates based in CDMX.




Must hold a current, valid U.S. visa and be available for international business travel.




Must be willing to travel internationally for meetings, conferences, and startup events.




What you’ve accomplished, how you think, and what drives you matter far more than your degree or job titles.




If you’re looking for a predictable 9-to-5, this isn’t it. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys doing whatever it takes to win, and the constant learning that come with building a startup.




How to apply




Skip the generic cover letter. We want to get to know you.




Along with your CV or LinkedIn profile, answer two questions:




1. Tell us about something you’ve built or made happen that you’re genuinely proud of. What was it, what did you do, and what happened?




2. Tell us something interesting about yourself that has absolutely nothing to do with work. An unusual passion, an experience, an obsession, anything that tells us something about you.




Please no AI slop. We want to hear your voice, not ChatGPT’s idea of what an impressive candidate sounds like. Use AI all you want, but bring your own thinking.




If your ambition is to build a startup someday, come build with us first.

Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo - SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Así será tu día a día en Skeelo:

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

description:

Viva Talent · Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators, creating meaningful career opportunities for women across Latin America while welcoming talent of all genders. We’re a globally distributed team of 240+ people across 16+ countries and 3 continents.




Why this role exists

You'll build and improve the systems that connect Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, from first touch through expansion. You’ll use data to spot what’s slowing growth, recommend our next growth bets, and work with department heads to implement improvements and track their impact.




This is a fully hands-on role with no direct reports.

Own HubSpot and our GTM stack. Manage lifecycle stages and fields, data quality, integrations, conversion syncing with advertising platforms, tool access, and costs.

Build and implement AI-enabled workflows. Automate repetitive GTM work and validate the accuracy and value of the outputs.

Recommend growth and investment priorities. Identify opportunities to accelerate Viva’s core growth metric and recommend where to focus resources based on expected impact, speed to results, risks, and trade-offs.




Who you are

5+ years in Revenue Operations, with hands-on ownership of systems and processes across the customer lifecycle.
C1 English and executive communication skills. You explain recommendations clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and align stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid‑market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast‑growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high‑quality execution.

About The Role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

What you will do

Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e‑signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed‑deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal‑risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

Remote‑first environment

Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US‑based enterprises

20 working days of PTO per year

US holidays and additional days off

Professional development reimbursement

description:
Overview

Are you an experienced project manager with a strong background in marketing? Do you have 5+ years of experience managing successful projects and a passion for driving marketing initiatives?




If so, we want you on our team! We are seeking a dedicated Digital Marketing Project Manager who excels in project management and has a solid understanding of marketing principles.




Join us and lead impactful marketing projects to success.




The Basics

This role is ideal for someone who is a Project Manager first and a Marketer second. As a marketing agency, we welcome as much marketing experience as possible, but this role is for someone who lives and breathes Project Management, thrives on creating order, and can efficiently balance team capacity vs. client scope.




Even though our team is located all over the globe, most of our clients are based in the US and speak English. As such, we require all candidates to have C1/C2 fluency of English and be willing to work East Coast US hours.




Description

ProperExpression is a boutique growth marketing agency specializing in Wealth Managment, SaaS and Professional Services. We partner with some of the most forward-thinking companies in the world. We've been around for 7 years and are continuing to grow at a rapid pace. As a HubSpot Platinum Partner, we've been recognized as a top agency by Excellence.com and Clutch.




Why ProperExpression?

Exciting Clients: Work with cutting-edge marketing tech and growth-progressive organizations.
Growth Opportunities: Join our rapid expansion and shape your career.
Dynamic Culture: Enjoy a fast-paced, collaborative, and supportive team culture.
Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in North America, South America or Europe, with flexible hours aligned to USA East Coast time.




Requirements




The Fundamentals:

Organized and process-driven. High attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Tech-Savvy: ability to learn and master how to use project management and marketing software
Excellent communication and writing skills.
Driven, self-starter personality.
Eager to learn and constantly looking to improve.




Direct Experience (The Must-Haves)

Project management experience at a marketing agency or an in-house marketing team.
Direct experience with a project management platform like ClickUp (preferred), Asana, Monday.com, Wrike, Jira or similar.




Direct Experience (Preferred But Not Required)

Experience with Agile methodology.
Experience with HubSpot’s Marketing Hub or Sales Hub.
Experience with Google’s marketing suite of products including Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Google My Business, Tag Manager, etc.
Some Experience with WordPress or another CMS.
B2B Marketing experience
Familiar with the principles of demand generation, digital advertising, SEO, and content marketing.




Responsibilities

Project Management:

Become the ClickUp Master: manage and build ClickUp projects, lists, tasks and templates. Keep the entire team on track and on deadline!
Internal Team Coordination: Own and monitor internal team assignments, follow up with task owners and stakeholders, and ensure all tasks are progressing as planned.
Manage external contractors, direct their work, and exert quality control over their deliverables. This may include designers, copy writers, web developers, etc.
Resource Management: track hours, coordinate estimates and make sure the team is operating efficiently and at a high utilization rate.




Marketing Execution

Campaign Planning and Coordination: Collaborate with Strategists, PPC experts, SEO specialists, designers, copywriters, and other subject matter experts to plan and coordinate powerful marketing campaigns that drive measurable results for our clients.
Strategic Development: Partner with account managers and directors to create and implement detailed multi-channel campaign briefs, including email marketing, website optimization, and paid channels.
Development Implementation: Oversee the implementation of website and landing page development in close conjunction with creative director, designers and developers.




Benefits

Flexible working hours
Generous PTO
Professional development program, including travel to conferences and events
Travel and accommodation to the annual company retreat




Application Instructions

Please read and follow the application instructions to ensure your application is considered.

This position is geared towards those with a strong Project Management background. If you don't have direct project management experience in a marketing team or organization, your application will not be considered.
Please don't email or send us a LinkedIn message until we've reached out to you.
Please indicate what your favorite animal is and why in the 'Additional Comments' field at the end of the application.




We're looking forward to getting to know you!

title: Marketing Operations Manager (fixed term)
skills: Marketing Operations and Project Management: Maintain a comprehensive overview of ongoing marketing projects, tracking deadlines, dependencies, priorities and potential risks across the department.
Coordinate recurring departmental meetings, document key decisions, assign action items and ensure timely follow-through.
Proactively follow up with team members and stakeholders to resolve routine blockers and keep projects progressing.
Provide leadership with concise, regular updates on project progress, emerging risks, priorities and decisions requiring attention.
Identify situations requiring management input and present clear recommendations or alternative solutions.

Campaign and Launch Coordination: Support campaign leads in translating strategic priorities into actionable project plans with clearly defined responsibilities, timelines, deliverables and launch dates.
Coordinate activities across copywriting, design, web development, email marketing, events and Sales to ensure successful campaign execution.
Monitor campaign readiness by checking that all required assets, follow-up journeys, Sales handoffs and performance tracking arrangements are in place.
Identify missing deliverables, unclear ownership, incomplete follow-up processes and other potential execution gaps before they affect launch timelines.
Support the coordination of marketing campaigns, product launches, webinars and events across consumer and B2B business activities.

Process and Systems Management: Maintain efficient, practical and repeatable operational processes, identifying opportunities for improvement without introducing unnecessary administrative complexity.
Keep project management platforms organized, updated and consistently used across the department.
Consolidate routine information from existing reports and dashboards to provide leadership with relevant operational insights.
Help maintain visibility and accountability across workflows, ensuring teams have the information and tools needed to deliver effectively.
Transition and Handover: Work closely with the current Marketing Operations Manager to understand existing processes and progressively assume agreed responsibilities.
Document operational workflows, ongoing projects, key decisions and outstanding tasks to ensure a smooth transition.
Maintain clear records of process changes and unresolved priorities throughout the contract period.
At least 4 years of professional experience in marketing operations, marketing project management, program management or a similar position within a marketing department.
Proven experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously and managing deadlines, dependencies and deliverables across cross-functional teams.
Strong understanding of marketing operations and the processes involved in campaigns, product launches, webinars, events and Sales handoffs.
Ability to assess campaign readiness, identify missing elements and anticipate operational challenges before they affect execution.
Experience coordinating stakeholders and influencing progress without having direct managerial authority over contributors.
Familiarity with project management platforms, CRM systems and marketing automation tools. HubSpot experience is considered an advantage.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written communication skills and the ability to provide clear, proactive updates to stakeholders and leadership.
Strong problem-solving abilities, sound judgment and the confidence to resolve routine operational issues independently while escalating more complex decisions appropriately.
Experience facilitating meetings, documenting decisions, tracking action items and maintaining accountability across distributed teams.
Ability to develop and improve operational processes while keeping workflows simple, practical and efficient.
Comfortable working in a fully remote, international environment and collaborating across different functions and time zones.
Ability to start immediately and integrate quickly into an established team for a defined contract period.
Adaptability, intellectual curiosity, creativity and a willingness to experiment with new approaches and learn from challenges.
Strong personal integrity, accountability and commitment to making thoughtful, responsible decisions.
Genuine interest in contributing to a mission focused on improving global opportunities, accessibility and social protection for remote workers.
Competitive compensation ranging from $30 to $34 per hour.
Fixed-term contract of 6–12 months.
Fully remote working environment, with the flexibility to work from anywhere globally.
Access to a global health, income and travel protection offering.
Potential eligibility for equity compensation.
Annual home office allowance.
Opportunity to collaborate with a fully remote international team distributed across multiple time zones.
Exposure to cross-functional marketing operations spanning consumer and B2B business activities.
Opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission focused on building a global social safety net for remote workers.
Dynamic working environment encouraging independent thinking, creativity, experimentation and continuous learning.

skills: Develop and oversee paid media strategies across Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, X, and other relevant advertising platforms.

Lead strategic client discussions, present performance insights, communicate recommendations, and explain key advertising decisions.
Challenge existing assumptions when performance data supports alternative approaches.
Proactively identify opportunities to expand account growth through new channels, audiences, creative strategies, offers, and funnel improvements.
Leverage data, technology, and AI-powered tools to improve decision-making and campaign effectiveness.
At least 6 years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, growth marketing, or a related field.
Significant experience managing e-commerce clients is essential.
Strong hands-on experience managing campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok.
Additional experience with advertising platforms such as Snapchat and X is an advantage.
Proven experience managing substantial advertising budgets.
A track record of developing and executing paid media strategies that deliver measurable business growth.
Strong understanding of e-commerce performance metrics, customer acquisition economics, conversion rates, and funnel optimization.
Experience with creative testing, offer experimentation, landing page optimization, and customer journey improvements.
Experience collaborating with Creative, Analytics, Growth, and other cross-functional teams.
Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to develop and present strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
A commercially driven mindset, with a focus on profitable growth, customer economics, conversion, and retention rather than isolated advertising metrics.
The ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and proactively identify opportunities without waiting for direction.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
Familiarity with data, marketing technology, and AI tools to improve operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.
Fully remote working arrangement, with opportunities open to candidates globally.
Significant ownership and autonomy over a portfolio of e-commerce clients.
Opportunity to work with ambitious consumer brands across health, wellness, beauty, nutrition, personal care, and lifestyle.
Collaboration with experienced professionals across media buying, creative strategy, analytics, growth, and technology.
Access to proprietary marketing intelligence tools and advanced AI-powered technologies.
Exposure to large-scale advertising operations, supported by a network of more than 400,000 creators and over $850 million in annual media spend managed across the organization.
Opportunities to influence broader business growth beyond traditional media buying responsibilities.
Professional development and potential career progression into media leadership, strategic planning, or broader growth management roles.
A distributed working environment built around trust, accountability, ownership, and execution.
Opportunities to experiment with innovative advertising strategies and contribute to the growth of leading consumer brands.

description:
¡Únete a GOALS AGENCY como Paid Media Specialist / Trafficker Digital MID-SR!




En GOALS AGENCY no buscamos solo personas que den "clic" en el botón de promocionar. Buscamos un perfil con criterio analítico, velocidad, experiencia real y la capacidad de optimizar presupuestos bajo el ritmo dinámico de una agencia creativa.




Aquí no nos quedamos en "se ve bonito": medimos lo que funciona, corregimos en tiempo real, generamos resultados tangibles y escalamos cuentas todos los días.




IMPORTANTE:




Esta vacante NO es para perfiles junior ni principiantes. Requerimos a alguien que ya haya quemado pestañas optimizando campañas reales y que sepa qué hacer cuando un costo por adquisición (CPA) se eleva.




Antes de aplicar:




Conoce nuestro trabajo y asegúrate de conectar con nuestro estilo:




goals.com.mx




¿Qué buscamos?




Experiencia REAL en agencia de marketing, publicidad o manejando un portafolio robusto de multi-cuentas.

Dominio sólido y avanzado de:

Meta Business Suite (Anuncios de conversión, catálogos, CBO/ABO, píxeles, API de conversiones).

Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube Ads).

TikTok Ads (Formatos de tendencia, optimización de conversiones).

Google Analytics (GA4) y Looker Studio (para armado de dashboards).

Experiencia indispensable en:

Estrategia digital integral (paso de funnel: awareness, consideración, conversión, retargeting).

Estructuración de presupuestos y proyecciones de inversión.

Análisis profundo de métricas clave: CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, CTR, ROAS y ROI.

Auditoría de cuentas y detección de fugas de presupuesto.

Generación de reportes mensuales con insights accionables (conclusiones reales, no solo vaciado de datos).

Capacidad para:

Trabajar rápido, bajo presión y con alto criterio de negocio.

Manejar múltiples cuentas de distintos giros al mismo tiempo sin perder el control.

Resolver problemas técnicos de tracking y optimización de forma autónoma.

Coordinarse de manera clara con el equipo de diseño y contenido para pedir los materiales visuales (hooks, copys, formatos) que sí convierten.

Nos interesa alguien:




Analítico/a con los datos.

Resolutivo/a y proactivo/a (que proponga cambios de estrategia antes de que el cliente los pida).

Organizado/a y con extrema atención al detalle (un cero de más en la pauta puede costar caro).

Que no necesite supervisión constante y domine sus plataformas.

Requerimientos:




Conocimiento en automatización de reportes.

Experiencia en pauta para E-commerce complejos (Shopify / WooCommerce).

Apoyo con herramientas de IA.

¿Qué harás?




Estrategia, configuración, segmentación y optimización diaria de campañas digitales en Meta, Google y TikTok.

Monitoreo diario del rendimiento de cuentas para asegurar el cumplimiento de KPIs.

Análisis e interpretación de datos para toma de decisiones ágiles.

Armado y presentación de reportes mensuales de resultados con próximos pasos estratégicos.

Trabajo colaborativo con el equipo creativo para asegurar que los anuncios estén alineados al objetivo técnico de la campaña.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst | Channel Partner B2B
description:
Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Así será tu día a día en Skeelo:

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Para Esto, Necesitarás

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Capacidad para gestionar cronogramas de proyectos y lanzamientos de socios con autonomía y organización.

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Y sería un gran plus si también cuentas con:

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau o AppsFlyer.

¿Y los beneficios?

Modelo de trabajo Remote First, con encuentros presenciales durante el año en São Paulo, con toda la logística cubierta por la empresa.

Bono anual por encima del promedio del mercado.

Días festivos locales, respetando la cultura de cada país.

Horarios flexibles, con hasta 2 horas de flexibilidad al inicio o final del día.

Programas de desarrollo: Ruta de Carrera, Universidad Skeelo y reconocimientos internos.

Día libre durante el mes de tu cumpleaños.

Licencia de maternidad y paternidad según la legislación local.

title: Senior Manager, Regional Customers, Mexico
skills: The role requires deep understanding of Modern Trade as well as strong leadership and accountability to influence our cross-functional System teams towards consumer- and customer-relevant plans that drive revenue, share of value and profit growth with a sustainable long-term competitive advantage.
Execute commercial tactical plans to guarantee compliance with sales and profitability objectives assigned by Lead KAM and KAM
Manage customer-facing categories in operational terms and delivery compliance
Manage commercial relationships of categories and assigned customers, managing the direct relationship with Category Buyer and Sales Assistant of self-service chains
Support coordination of operational activities of administration and supply
Develop a deep understanding of key customer needs and requirements to prepare customized solutions
Monitor customer performance under the metrics stipulated in the category and suggest improvement actions when necessary
Follow up on orders and analyze various process, quality, and performance indicators (e.g., fill rate, turnover, price)
Develop strategic plans to unlock growth opportunities with Modern Trade formats focused on occasion development and portfolio expansion opportunities.

Manage key customer relationships to collaborate on building the activation calendar by briefing marketing for brand/communications needs while co-developing customer plans with bottlers and customers.
Coordinate with customers and bottlers the implementation of planned activities.
Deploy category vision and ensure consistency of value propositions for Modern Trade formats in its market (e.g. recruitment, trial, frequency) in collaboration with the customer and bottlers.
Develop customer business plan in collaboration with bottlers, including brand and package portfolio priorities and activation plans.
Be the System expert on Modern Trade business/formats, able to reflect a consumer, shopper, and local customer’s perspective as well as a System execution capability within the customer/channel.
Provide insight into category growth opportunities to category leads and to country operations.
Partner with OU category leads to align - occasion-centric – on key categories and activation to deploy with customer different formats/banners while including experiential marketing.
Manage customer-specific DME as well as DME allocated to perform the work in scope.
Education Requirements: Bachelor's Degree
Related Work Experience:
3+ years of leadership experience in customer management, commercial, and operational marketing.
Senior and strategic customer management across territories and bottlers with an execution perspective.
Strong planning, communication, and collaboration skills.
Ability to think from planning to execution and solid system customer, commercial, and brand management.
Desirable: candidates with Bottler experience
Functional Skills:
Mastery of (Required): System Planning, Channel/Shopper Marketing, Customer Management, RGM, including Segmentation & OBPPC, and System and Customer Economics.
Broad Expertise In (Good To Have): Turning Insights (Consumer, Shopper, Customer) Into Strategy, Category Management, Value to Market, Project Management, and Supply Chain.
Communication Focus:
Internal communication includes providing direction to marketing for brand/communications needs for path-to-purchase activation with Modern Trade formats.
External communication includes customer engagement across all markets in Latin America and at HQ level.
Influencing and negotiation skills are essential for this role, as it will influence action on mutual strategies as well as securing investment for implementation.
Iconic Brand: Work on the most recognized brand in the world and be part of developing the next chapter.
Exposure to World-Class Leaders: Access to global marketing leaders who will expand your network and expose you to emerging digital platforms and marketing insights.
Creative Team Culture: Be inspired by the best brand leaders and agencies in the world, which creates a creative culture that supports taking risks and innovation.

Sólidas habilidades analíticas, de modelado financiero y de investigación de mercado.

Alta capacidad de autogestión y organización para trabajar eficazmente de forma remota.

Sólidas habilidades analíticas, de modelado financiero y de investigación de mercado.

Dominio de herramientas de análisis de mercado y CRM.

Alta capacidad de autogestión y organización para trabajar eficazmente de forma remota.

Ofrecemos una remuneración excepcional, que incluye un salario base muy competitivo, bonificaciones significativas por desempeño y amplias oportunidades de desarrollo profesional en un rol que permite trabajar de forma totalmente remota. description:
Descripción General del Puesto

Brother Mexico is seeking a Senior Director, Sales & Marketing to lead the commercial strategy and accelerate sustainable, profitable growth across our Consumer and Commercial businesses.

This executive role will have overall leadership responsibility for Sales and Marketing across the Printing & Solutions (P&S), Labeling & Mobile (L&M), Personal & Home (P&H), and Industrial Printing (IP) portfolios, representing a business of MXN 2.5B+ in annual revenue.

The Senior Director will set the commercial direction for Mexico, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, expand market share, and build a high-performing Sales & Marketing organization.

As a key business leader, this position will also work closely with senior stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Service, HR, and other functions, as well as Brother's regional and global headquarters, to shape priorities and position the Mexico business for its next stage of growth.

This role requires full business fluency in both English and Spanish. Please share your resume/CV/profile in ENGLISH. The interview experience may feature participants engaging with you in each language.

Funciones y Responsabilidades

Commercial & Business Strategy


Own and lead the Sales & Marketing strategy for Mexico, with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, market share, and commercial performance.
Translate corporate priorities into clear annual and multi-year commercial strategies and execution plans.
Establish and deliver against annual and quarterly sales objectives across business segments and channels.
Identify and accelerate new business, channel, customer, and market opportunities.
Continuously evaluate and evolve Brother's Go-to-Market strategy, responding with agility to changes in customers, channels, competitors, and market dynamics.
Drive disciplined management of pricing, commercial conditions, partner programs, incentives, and promotional investments.
Use business intelligence, customer insights, and competitive data to anticipate risks and unlock growth opportunities.
Build strong relationships with strategic customers, partners, and key industry stakeholders.

Sales & Marketing Leadership


Lead an integrated Sales & Marketing organization, creating strong alignment between commercial strategy, product strategy, channels, and market execution.
Define portfolio, product, channel, pricing, and demand-generation strategies that support sustainable business growth.
Oversee key marketing priorities including product launches, digital marketing, brand strategy, customer engagement, public relations, social media, and channel activation.
Ensure marketing investments, promotional funds, and rebates deliver measurable business impact and ROI.
Strengthen collaboration between Sales and Marketing to create an integrated, customer-centric commercial organization.
Represent Brother Mexico at strategic customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and executive forums.

Organizational Leadership


Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Sales & Marketing leadership team.
Establish clear accountability, performance expectations, and decision-making disciplines across the organization.
Coach and develop leaders while strengthening succession planning and organizational capabilities.
Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, agility, and performance.
Lead by example through Brother's cultural drivers of Accountability, Authenticity, Boldness, and Excellence.
Provide strategic perspective and recommendations to senior leadership on business opportunities, organizational priorities, and market dynamics.

Financial & Operational Performance


Lead commercial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management for the business.
Monitor revenue, profitability, market share, pipeline, forecast accuracy, and other critical commercial KPIs.
Partner closely with Finance and Supply Chain to align commercial plans, product forecasts, inventory, and business priorities.
Regularly assess actual performance against targets and adjust strategies, resources, territories, or commercial programs as required.
Deliver executive-level business reviews and recommendations to regional and global leadership.

Global & Cross-Functional Partnership


Serve as a senior commercial partner to Brother International Corporation (BIC) in the U.S. and Brother Industries, Ltd. (BIL) in Japan.
Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders to secure the capabilities and resources required to execute the Mexico growth strategy.
Collaborate with Brother subsidiaries and global business units on strategic initiatives, portfolio priorities, and market opportunities.

Experiencia y Calificaciones

We are looking for an accomplished commercial leader with the strategic perspective, business acumen, and leadership capability to drive a complex, multi-category business.

Experience & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
15+ years of progressive Sales and/or Marketing experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility.

Experience within consumer technology, consumer goods, office technology, electronics, or related industries strongly preferred.

Proven ability to translate strategy into disciplined execution and measurable results.

Strong understanding of Product Marketing and the ability to lead an integrated Sales & Marketing agenda.

Ability to lead through complexity and organizational change.
A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders.
Resilience, agility, and the ability to identify creative paths to sustainable business growth.

Detalles Adicionales de la Posición

Company Overview

Brother is a leading provider of home and office equipment, sewing and crafting products, and industrial solutions. With a legacy spanning over 115 years, our brand is renowned for producing award-winning printers, sewing machines, P-touch labelers, and more. Brother Mexico was established in 1992, marking over 30 years of operations. It is headquartered in Mexico City and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Brother International Corporation (BIC), based in the United States. BIC is in itself a subsidiary of Brother Industries Limited (BIL), which was founded in 1908 in Nagoya, Japan, and operates in more than 30 countries worldwide.

Why Work at Brother?

At Brother México, we are proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace where every voice is valued. Our hiring practices and internal programs promote equity and belonging across all levels of the organization. We are committed to fostering a workplace culture that reflects with our core values: inclusivity, collaboration, customer-centric, and social responsibility. We value work flexibility, offering a hybrid office schedule with home office half days on Fridays, a casual dress code, and additional days off throughout the year. We are also dedicated to employee growth and development, providing facilitated courses and resources to our employees for self-paced learning resources.

Our Benefits

We offer a range of benefits designed to support the well-being of our employees, including medical, dental, and life insurance. We also support our employees with family-focused benefits, ranging from additional maternity leave days to opportunities for prioritizing children's school events -even when they fall occur during the workday. title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid‑market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast‑growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high‑quality execution.

About The Role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

What you will do

Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e‑signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed‑deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal‑risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

Remote‑first environment

Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US‑based enterprises

20 working days of PTO per year

US holidays and additional days off

Professional development reimbursement

title: Head of Local Marketing & Partnerships
description:
Who We Are

AvantStay delivers world class, authentic, tech-enabled short-term rental(“STR”) group experiences targeted at the millennial generation. We are venture funded and growing rapidly in the explosive $100+ billion dollar STR industry. We deliver a customized end-to-end experience that is tailored just for groups and powered with technology at every layer.

What We're Looking For

AvantStay is in dozens of U.S. markets, and each one has its own rhythm, its own partners and its own way of getting noticed. A national brand can only get you so far in Scottsdale or the Smokies. The rest comes from being known locally: by the restaurant that recommends you, the planner who books you, the realtor who sends you owners. We're looking for a Head of Local Marketing & Partnerships to make AvantStay feel like home turf in every market we operate in.

You'll build local marketing at AvantStay from scratch and run it across every market, as the marketing partner to each of our area managers. You'll decide how each market earns attention, which relationships are worth building, and where the money goes. You'll own the budget across all of it, and the practical side that makes local marketing real: the things we put in homes, the materials in the field, the vendors who make them. You'll find partners, pitch them and close them yourself. You will not inherit a playbook. You'll write it, prove it, then teach it to every area manager.

If cold email and cold calls drain you, this is the wrong job. If a yes from a stranger makes your week, read on.

What this title means here: you are the first hire in this function. No team yet, budget authority from day one, and you report to our VP of Growth.

What You’ll Do

The local plan. A clear, simple strategy for every market, built with its area manager.

The budget. How much each market gets, what it returns, and the monthly case for moving it.

Local partnerships. The relationships that put AvantStay in front of guests and owners where they already are. You source them, pitch them and close them.

Local campaigns. Market-specific promotions, content and offers that drive direct bookings and owner leads.

The physical side. Branded merchandise, welcome touches, collateral and print, from vendor to doorstep, in every market.

Launches. How a new market or hotel shows up locally from day one.

Local reputation. Our presence in local listings, press and the community, so we're the operator people know.

The playbook. Templates, scripts, kits and a request system that let every area manager run local marketing without starting from zero.

What You’ll Bring

Partnerships you landed through your own cold outreach, and the emails and calls that did it.

Experience planning and tracking marketing budget across many locations or markets at once, and moving money when the results said to.

Hands-on experience with branded merchandise, print and fulfillment: vendors, quotes, quality, timelines, inventory. You've had an order go wrong and fixed it.

The follow-up discipline to keep going after the first no.

Strong organization. You can run 10 to 30 markets at different stages without dropping any, with a clean pipeline in a CRM.

Clear, friendly writing and speaking that works with a small-town restaurant owner and a destination marketing director alike.

Working knowledge of local listings and local SEO basics, email tools and spreadsheets, plus AI tools to research markets and draft outreach.

3+ years in local, regional or field marketing, partnerships or business development for a multi-location consumer brand (hospitality, fitness, restaurants, real estate or tourism). We care more about the partners you've closed than the years.

Nice To Have

You know U.S. destination and tourism markets.

You've launched new locations or markets for a brand.

Event planning or hospitality operations experience.

This Role Is Not

B2B field marketing. No trade shows, no ABM, no pipeline targets for a sales team.

A paid media role. You'll work with paid, but you won't run the accounts.

An events-only role. Events are one tool among many.

A desk job in your own time zone. You'll be on the phone with partners during their business hours.

Logistics

This role is only open to global candidates outside the United States

Must be able to work US business hours (Pacific, Central, or Eastern time)

Must have excellent written and spoken English (near-native)

Fully remote

Generous paid time off, including local holiday

A build-from-zero mandate with budget authority from day one.

You report to our VP of Growth.
